references.text: The Lord was with Joseph – the direct context that establishes God's presence with Joseph
Abimelek said to Abraham: 'God is with you in all you do' – a similar recognition of God's presence from an outsider
The righteous is like a tree planted by streams of water – everything he does prospers. A parallel to how everything Joseph did succeeded.
God has said: I will never leave you nor forsake you – God's faithful presence
A prayer that the Lord's favor rests upon us and that the work of our hands succeeds – a parallel to how the Lord made Joseph's work succeed
This reference confirms the theological pattern that divine presence is the source of human success, linking Joseph's life directly to David's as an example of this principle.
This reference shows how God's presence and blessing followed Joseph consistently through various life situations (house and prison), confirmed by two different authorities.
